dogecoin.text: Market Movements: Bitcoin surged 3.3% to $87,518, driven by a sharp decline in the U.S. dollar (DXY at 98.5, its lowest since April 2022). Ethereum and altcoins like XRP, Solana, and Dogecoin also saw gains, pushing the global crypto market cap to $2.75 trillion. #CryptoTrading

Market Trends: The broader crypto market saw gains earlier this week, with the CoinDesk 20 Index up 5.2%. Altcoins like Ethereum (ETH) at $1,700, Dogecoin (DOGE), and Sui (SUI) also rose significantly, though some have since cooled. #CryptoNews
